stories.story_fr: Le résultat d'exploitation du groupe a augmenté, le retour sur fonds propres IFRS a progressé et la génération de capital et de liquidités est en hausse.
stories.story_en: Group operating profit rose, IFRS return on equity increased and capital and cash generation are growing.
stories.quote: Group operating profit rose, IFRS return on equity increased and capital and cash generation are growing.

stories.story_fr: Le dividende final a augmenté de 10% d'une année sur l'autre.
stories.story_en: Our final dividend is up 10% year-on-year.
stories.quote: Our final dividend is up 10% year-on-year.

stories.story_fr: Le rachat d'actions reprend, à un niveau plus élevé de 350 m£.
stories.story_en: We are resuming the share buyback, now at a higher level of £350m.
stories.quote: We are resuming the share buyback, now at a higher level of £350m.

stories.story_fr: Dans l'assurance générale, les primes sont en hausse de 18 %.
stories.story_en: In General Insurance, premiums are up 18%.
stories.quote: In General Insurance, premiums are up 18%.

stories.story_fr: Nous avons atteint nos objectifs 2026 un an plus tôt et avons relevé nos ambitions avec de nouveaux objectifs.
stories.story_en: We have now achieved our Group 2026 targets a year early and have raised our ambitions with new targets.
stories.quote: We have now achieved our Group 2026 targets a year early and have raised our ambitions with new targets.
